record.name: AICoding
record.offering: Developer Tools app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Introducing AICoding, the revolutionary app that uses cutting-edge AI technology (the openAI API) to generate high-quality code for the Swift, Kotlin, Java, and Bash programming languages. With AICoding, you can quickly and easily create robust and efficient code that adheres to best practices and coding standards. The app has the open-source Standard Library documents inside; just select a language, a topic, and an item, and use the many preprogrammed AI prompt buttons to generate code and explanations for you. You also have a free prompt to enter your own questions for the bot.

AICoding is designed to make coding faster, more efficient, and more secure. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced programmer, AICoding can help you streamline your coding process and save you time and effort. Here are some of the key features of the app:

* AI-powered code generation: AICoding uses advanced AI algorithms to generate Swift, Kotlin, & Java code based on your input. Simply enter your requirements * and let the app do the rest!

* Code examples: AICoding provides a range of code examples that demonstrate how to use different features and functions. Whether you need to create a new function, work with arrays or dictionaries, or implement a complex algorithm, AICoding has you covered.

* XCTest and Test in AICoding teach you how to write tests and make your code regression-proof.

* Code security: Security is a top priority for AICoding. The app uses advanced security measures to ensure that your code is safe from unauthorized access or tampering.

* Code takeaways: AICoding provides useful tips and takeaways that can help you improve your coding skills and learn new techniques.

* Code tips: AICoding offers a range of helpful tips that can help you improve your coding skills and productivity.

* Support for alternative languages: In addition to Swift, AICoding also supports equivalent code examples for other popular programming languages such as Objective-C, Kotlin, Java, and Dart. This makes it easy to switch between languages and leverage your existing skills and knowledge.

* Produce crash-safe code: AICoding goes beyond simply generating code by also prioritizing the stability and reliability of the code it produces. The app uses advanced algorithms to identify potential issues and generate code that is less likely to cause crashes or errors.

* AICoding makes it easy to add comments to your code by allowing you to paste your own code and ask the app to generate comments for it. This feature can save you time and effort and also help you improve the readability and maintainability of your code.

* Free user input: write your own questions, and the AI will respond. Your prompt must be related to the code language selected.

* You can reply to the chat of the AI bot for better tuning results or just ask for more examples; the chat history is preserved and the bot remembers context.

* JSON Object Creator: Paste JSON in the app, and the bot generates your Struct / Data Classes together with download code.

* SwiftUI code generation, including animations.

* UIKit code generation, over 110 prompts.

* Jetpack Compose code generation.

* Code interview questions: AICoding includes a range of coding interview questions and challenges that can help you prepare for job interviews or improve your coding skills.

* Don't want to write your own app description, keywords, promotions, and icon design in the App Store? Let AICoding do all that creative work for you.

* Use the app on the Mac for daily use, on the iPad maybe as a second screen, and on the iPhone for on-the-go and easy learning.

AICoding is the ultimate tool for anyone who wants to learn or create high-quality, efficient code for the supported programming language. Download AICoding today and start coding like a pro!

The word Swift is a trademark from Apple; Kotlin is a trademark from the Kotlin Foundation; and Java is a trademark from Oracle.

record.name: Mobile IDE for Claude Code AI
record.offering: Developer Tools app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Mobile IDE for Claude Code lets you control Claude Code on your Mac from your iPhone. Send prompts, watch the agent work, and ship code while you're away from the desk.

WHY THIS APP

Claude Code is a powerful agentic coding tool — but until now, you had to be at your computer to use it. Mobile IDE lifts that constraint. Connect your Mac, send a prompt from your phone, and Claude writes, edits, and runs code in your project — wherever you are.

WHAT YOU GET

- Real-time control. Send prompts to your Mac's Claude Code session and see the agent's response on your iPhone.
- Every Claude model. Pick Opus, Sonnet, or Haiku per task with one tap. Switch on the fly when you need speed or depth.
- Prompt Book. A curated library of prompts for code review, refactoring, architecture decisions, design patterns, and more.
- Agentic Coding. Not just chat — Claude reads your files, writes new ones, runs commands, and iterates until the task is done.
- No API keys. No CLI configuration on the phone. Pair your Mac once, then it just works.
- Voice input. Dictate your prompts when typing on a small screen isn't ideal.
- Unlimited prompts on subscription. No per-message fees, no token meters.

GETTING STARTED

1. Open the app on your iPhone.
2. Run the setup helper on your Mac (link inside the app).
3. Pair your devices in seconds.

PRIVACY

Your code and prompts go between your iPhone and your Mac. We don't store or read the contents of your sessions on our servers.

SUBSCRIPTION

Try free messages first. When you're ready for unlimited use, upgrade to monthly or yearly — cancel anytime in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.

DISCLAIMER

Mobile IDE for Claude Code is an independent, third-party client. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Anthropic. "Claude" and "Claude Code" are trademarks of their respective owners; we reference them only to describe what this app integrates with.

For support: support@luch.dev

record.offering: Developer Tools app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Take the power of your local AI dev stack everywhere. OpenMono is the official mobile companion for OpenMonoAgent.ai—the open-source, terminal-native coding agent that you own, not rent.

Why OpenMono?
OpenMono is built on the belief that AI should be infrastructure sitting on your desk, serving your code, and answering only to you. This app enables "Dual-Box" mode: run heavy inference on your home GPU rig (RTX 3090/4090/5090) and control the agentic workflow securely from your iPhone.

Key Features: 
• Dual-Box Connectivity: Seamlessly bridge the gap between your mobile device and your local GPU infrastructure. Works behind any NAT/CGNAT via our secure outbound-only relay.
• Unlimited Tokens, Zero Cost: Stop watching the meter. Since the model runs on your hardware, your prompts are free, unlimited, and private forever.
• Agentic Code Execution: OpenMono doesn’t just suggest code; it reasons. Perform multi-file refactors, architectural analysis, and automated testing from a mobile-optimized terminal.
• Built for .NET Developers: Deep integration with Roslyn allows the agent to understand type hierarchies, call graphs, and cross-assembly references with compiler-level accuracy.
• Docker-Native Sandboxing: Every destructive operation is gated. Your code is bind-mounted into a container, ensuring the agent remains isolated and secure.
• MCP & Tooling Support: Access 20+ built-in tools and extend your agent’s capabilities via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Infrastructure Highlights:
• Local-first, always. No one else sees your code.
• Powered by C#/.NET.
• Supports high-performance LLMs (Qwen, Llama, etc.) optimized for your specific hardware.

Connect with Us:
Website: https://www.openmonoagent.ai
Twitter/X: @StartupHakk

record.name: Tactic Remote: AI Coding
record.offering: Developer Tools app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Your AI coding agents, within reach. Tactic Remote connects your iPhone and iPad to your own computer so you can continue conversations, follow terminal output, inspect files, and respond when a task needs you.

Your computer keeps working. You don't have to stay at your desk. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Amp, and Droid on compatible Mac, Linux, and Windows hosts.

CHAT AND LIVE TERMINAL
Follow streaming replies, code, and tool results in chat, or open the native terminal to enter commands and watch output. Choose an agent when creating a conversation. Each conversation keeps its own agent and context; start another conversation to use a different agent.

PROJECTS, FILES, AND SESSIONS
Find work by project, switch sessions, browse source files, and inspect file activity and Git changes. Worktree support helps organize separate tasks in the same repository.

REMOTE ACCESS AND TRUSTED DEVICES
Connect directly on your local network or use Tactic Relay to reach a paired computer over the internet. Relay connections use application-layer end-to-end encryption, so the relay cannot read session content. You can also use a Cloudflare Tunnel you configure.
Sign in to your Tactic account to manage trusted devices and bound hosts, add Passkeys, and revoke device access. Your computer and companion server must stay running for remote access.

VOICE, SHORTCUTS, AND ALERTS
Dictate with Apple Speech, on-device Whisper, or optional cloud speech. Reuse commands and prompts, and receive notifications when work finishes or needs your attention.

USAGE AT A GLANCE
Where supported, check usage and plan limits for the agent account signed in on your computer. The companion server reads this data locally; availability depends on the agent and account.

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
Check in and reply from iPhone, or use iPad sidebars, expanded panels, and keyboard shortcuts. The interface supports English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, and Spanish.

IPHONE, IPAD, AND THE WEB
Alongside the native app, use a browser to access your own development environment, view sessions, browse files, and use the terminal. A new browser must complete secure pairing before its first connection. Your computer and companion server must stay running.

FREE AND PRO
The free tier includes 2 saved computers, 2 sessions, 5 custom snippets, and 5 minutes of cloud speech per month.
Pro unlocks unlimited computers, sessions, and snippets, plus file upload and editing, the full Shell keyboard, custom quick prompts, all themes, and 35 minutes of cloud speech per month. Available through monthly or annual subscriptions, or a one-time Lifetime purchase.

YOUR ENVIRONMENT, YOUR CONTROL
Install the companion server and a supported coding agent on your computer, then sign in to and configure the agent. Tactic Remote does not provide an AI model or third-party agent account. Your computer continues to manage your projects, terminal processes, and agent credentials.
Optional product analytics excludes code, prompts, terminal output, file paths, and project names, and can be disabled in Settings. Audio is uploaded only when you choose cloud speech. Protect the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

Privacy Policy: https://tacticremote.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://tacticremote.com/terms

record.name: Drover: Steer AI Coding Agents
record.offering: Developer Tools app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Drover is a mobile client for the AI coding agents you run under Herdr on your
own computer. It turns them into something you can supervise from your phone.

It is not a mobile terminal. Drover speaks the agent's language: it renders a
running session as a readable chat, turns permission prompts into buttons you
can tap, and tells you the moment an agent is waiting on you.

NO SERVER IN BETWEEN
Drover connects straight from your device to your own machine over SSH. There
is no service in the middle. Your transcripts, your commands and your code go
to your machine — the developer of this app cannot see them. The voice
assistant is an experimental, opt-in exception: it sends to Google, not to the
developer, after you accept its disclosure.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• See every agent and its status at a glance — waiting for you, working, done
• Read the session as a chat, with Markdown, syntax-highlighted code and diffs
• Answer an agent's permission prompt by tapping a button instead of typing
  into a raw terminal pane
• Send follow-up instructions, cycle the agent's mode, or dictate by voice
• Talk to an agent hands-free with the experimental voice assistant — launch
  it, send it a message, or answer its question, and hear back what's happening
• Attach a photo from your camera or library for the agent to look at
• Get a notification the moment an agent is blocked and needs you
• Switch between several machines, or watch them all in one list

TRY IT WITH NO SETUP
Tap "Try the demo" on the first screen. It runs a scripted session entirely on
your device, with no host and no connection, so you can see how Drover works
before setting anything up.

WHAT YOU NEED
Drover is a client for a machine you already own. To use it for real you need a
computer running Herdr (herdr.dev) with your coding agents in it, SSH access to
that machine with key-based authentication, and Herdr 0.8.0 or newer.

PRIVACY
Dictation runs entirely on your device — Drover will not fa
The experimental voice assistant is different: it asks for your consent before
first use, and while a voice session is running your speech
transcripts, agent context and message drafts are sent to Google's Gemini.
Notifications carry a fixed message and never any of your t
key is stored in the iOS Keychain and never leaves your device.

Drover is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or
sponsored by the Herdr project, Anthropic, OpenAI, or GitHu
certified by any of them.

record.name: ViSH - AI Coding Terminal
record.offering: Developer Tools app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
ViSH turns your iPad into a portable, local ARM64 Linux workspace. Run Alpine Linux or Ubuntu 24.04 in a touch-friendly terminal, use AI coding CLIs, manage project files, or connect to remote servers over SSH. Your local Linux environment runs without a remote server.

ViSH requires an auto-renewing subscription (yearly or monthly) and offers a 7-day free trial. All features described below require an active subscription.

AI coding wherever you are

Install terminal tools such as Claude Code and Codex to explore code, write scripts, and refactor projects on iPad. Bring your own account or API key and configure your environment with guided setup.

Use apk on Alpine Linux or apt on Ubuntu 24.04. Install Git, OpenSSH, Node.js, npm, pnpm, nano, ripgrep, tmux, and common build tools as needed.

Manage files beside your terminal

The session file browser lets you browse local Linux or SSH server directories, view file details, import files and folders, create directories, and delete multiple items. Insert selected file paths directly into the terminal to save typing.

Keep multiple Linux filesystems, download supported systems or import your own archives, and switch which one boots. Each filesystem retains its login user, boot command, and setup state. Export tar.gz archives or browse all filesystems from a single ViSH location in the Files app.

Flexible SSH connections and protected keys

Save SSH servers with password or key authentication, jump hosts, port forwarding, keep-alive, and automatic tab reconnection.

On supported devices, create Secure Enclave SSH keys whose private keys stay inside secure hardware. Optionally require Face ID, Touch ID, or your device passcode when using a key. You can also import existing keys. Secure Enclave keys remain on the device where they were created.

Built for terminal work on iPad

Use multiple terminal tabs and long-press + to choose a local or SSH tab. Side panels bring files, shortcut keys, appearance, voice input, and SSH tools beside your main terminal workspace.

Make it your own with a phosphor-amber interface, 505 terminal themes with live previews, and coding fonts with glyph previews. Pinch to resize text, pin the shortcut bar, use sticky modifiers and command snippets, mirror the terminal in Picture in Picture, and open Linux links in Safari.

Connect serial hardware

Connect compatible Bluetooth serial adapters to Linux with modem controls and optional local RFC 2217 access. Settings includes device compatibility information and guidance for an ESP32 bridge to help you choose a connection method.

Notes

All app features require an active ViSH subscription after the 7-day free trial. Some Linux features are limited by the iOS sandbox. Third-party tools such as Claude Code and Codex require your own account or API key with those services and may require a separate paid plan purchased outside ViSH.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://vishapp.dev/privacy

Vibez is a focus app for developers who vibe code with AI agents.

When your coding agent is working, you can take a break, check your apps, or scroll without constantly wondering if it is done yet. When the agent finishes or needs your input, Vibez blocks your distracting apps so you come back to the code.

No more losing 30 minutes after a “quick” check.
No more forgetting your agent was waiting.
No more breaking your flow because you had to babysit the terminal.

Vibez connects with plugins for Claude Code and Codex, then uses Apple Screen Time controls to shield distracting apps at the exact moment your attention is needed again.

Use Vibez to:

• Scroll while your AI coding agent works
• Get pulled back when it needs review, approval, or input
• Block distracting apps when the task is ready
• Stay in the loop without staring at your terminal
• Turn AI coding downtime into controlled break time

Built for developers, vibe coders, and anyone using coding agents as part of their workflow.

Let the agent cook. Vibez will bring you back.

record.name: Cosyra: AI Coding Agents
record.offering: Developer Tools app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Cosyra gives you your own Linux computer in the cloud and a phone app built for running AI coding agents on it. Chat with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or OpenCode while they work on your projects, browse the files they change, preview what they build, dictate by voice, and open a full terminal whenever you want one.

YOUR OWN MACHINE
• A persistent Ubuntu machine with 30 GB of storage. Your repos, tools, dotfiles and agent sessions stay exactly where you left them.
• Sleeps when idle and wakes in seconds.
• 4 GB of RAM on Core, 8 GB on Pro. Nothing depends on your phone's CPU or battery.
• git, node, python and the rest of a normal developer toolchain, plus whatever you install.

AGENTS, NOT A CHATBOT
• Run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or OpenCode on your machine and talk to them from your phone.
• The agent edits files and runs commands with the permission level you choose.
• Queue follow-ups, steer work in progress, and switch agents on the same project.
• A running turn survives a dropped connection, and you get a notification when unattended work finishes.

PROJECTS, FILES AND PREVIEWS
• Link GitHub, clone repositories, open projects, switch branches, and inspect diffs.
• Browse and read files without typing paths.
• Preview the web apps your agents build through a secure, authenticated tunnel.

VOICE
• Dictate prompts. Speech is recognized on your device and tidied up before it reaches the agent.

A FULL TERMINAL WHEN YOU WANT ONE
• xterm-compatible terminal with smart keys, scrollback restoration and truecolor.
• Sessions keep running while the app is in the background and reconnect where they stopped.

BRING YOUR OWN MODELS
Connect Anthropic, OpenAI or another supported provider with your own API key or eligible subscription. Your subscription pays for the machine, not the model. Cosyra never resells model access.

PLANS
Core (4 GB RAM) and Pro (8 GB RAM), both with 30 GB of storage and a 7-day free trial. A subscription is required for machine access. Pricing is shown in the app before you start a trial.

PRIVACY AND SECURITY
• Provider API keys travel over TLS to encrypted server-side storage and are never saved on your phone.
• Every machine runs in its own isolated sandbox.
• Voice recognition runs on the device.
• Sign in with Apple, Google or GitHub.

Claude Code is a product of Anthropic, Codex of OpenAI and Cursor of Anysphere; OpenCode is an open-source project. Cosyra is not affiliated with or endorsed by any of them.
